import importlib.util, os
for name in ('pybox', 'pppybox'):
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(name)
    print(f"{name}: {'FOUND at ' + str(list(spec.submodule_search_locations)) if spec else 'not found'}")

import pybox
base = os.path.dirname(pybox.__file__)
print("\npybox contents:", os.path.dirname(pybox.__file__))
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d != '__pycache__']
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print("  ", p.replace(os.path.dirname(base), 'pybox'), os.path.getsize(p), "B")
